items.title: 68002_Benny Waters oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Eddie Beryls' and 'Eddie Barrow' as a piano player in a band, but the interviewee (Benny Waters) does not respond with any personal connection, memory, or confirmation of working with or knowing this individual.

ctx.x: And the piano player was named, a name like Beryl, Beryl, somethin' like that, Eddie Beryls, somethin' like that, a little semi-classical pianist that could play jazz. It wasn't considered a jazz band like Skinny Johnson and all those guys -
